properties.english_form: An AHB incrementing burst must not cross a 1KB address boundary.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge HCLK) disable iff (!HRESETn) (HTRANS == 2'b10 && HBURST != 3'b000 && !HBURST[1]) |-> ((HADDR[9:0] + ((burst_length(HBURST)) << HSIZE)) <= 11'h400));

properties.english_form: A Subordinate must always provide a zero-wait-state OKAY response to an IDLE transfer and must ignore the transfer.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge HCLK) disable iff (!HRESETn) (HSELx && HREADY && HTRANS == 2'b00) |=> (HREADYOUT && HRESP == 1'b0));

properties.english_form: A Subordinate must always provide a zero-wait-state OKAY response to a BUSY transfer and must ignore the transfer.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge HCLK) disable iff (!HRESETn) (HSELx && HREADY && HTRANS == 2'b01) |=> (HREADYOUT && HRESP == 1'b0));

properties.english_form: HSIZE, HBURST, HWRITE, HPROT, HMASTLOCK, and (AHB5) HNONSEC must remain constant for all beats of a burst.
properties.sva_form: // Beat tracker: within a burst (after first NONSEQ and before final SEQ/IDLE), HSIZE/HBURST/HWRITE/HPROT/HMASTLOCK/HNONSEC are unchanged.

properties.english_form: All transfers in a burst must be aligned to the address boundary equal to the size of the transfer; HADDR[log2(2^HSIZE)-1:0] = 0 for every beat.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge HCLK) disable iff (!HRESETn) (HSELx && HREADY && HTRANS inside {2'b10, 2'b11}) |-> ((HADDR & ((1 << HSIZE) - 1)) == 0));

properties.english_form: Wrapping bursts wrap at the address boundary equal to the number of beats multiplied by the transfer size in bytes; HBURST and HSIZE jointly determine the wrap boundary.
properties.sva_form: // WRAP4/8/16: address wraps at 4*2^HSIZE / 8*2^HSIZE / 16*2^HSIZE byte boundary respectively.

properties.english_form: The AHB ERROR response is a two-cycle response: cycle 1 HRESP=1+HREADY=0, cycle 2 HRESP=1+HREADY=1.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge HCLK) disable iff (!HRESETn) ($rose(HRESP) && HRESP==1'b1) |-> (!HREADYOUT) ##1 (HRESP==1'b1 && HREADYOUT));

properties.english_form: A Manager must not end a fixed-length burst (INCR4/8/16, WRAP4/8/16) with a BUSY transfer; fixed-length bursts must terminate with a SEQ transfer.
properties.sva_form: // Burst tracker: last beat of a fixed-length burst (4/8/16) must be HTRANS=SEQ, not BUSY.

properties.english_form: After a locked transfer it is recommended that the Manager inserts an IDLE transfer.
properties.sva_form: // Recommendation only: after the cycle in which HMASTLOCK falls from 1 to 0, the Manager should drive HTRANS=IDLE for one cycle.

properties.english_form: All transfers in a locked sequence (HMASTLOCK=1) must be to the same Subordinate address region. (Did not exist in Issue A; legacy components must be checked.)
properties.sva_form: // Decoder cross-check: during locked sequence, only one HSELx is asserted across all locked transfers.

properties.english_form: When the Subordinate is requesting wait states (HREADY=0), the Manager can only change the address once; the exceptions are during an IDLE transfer and after an ERROR response.
properties.sva_form: // Address held stable while HREADY=0, except IDLE-transition or post-ERROR.

properties.english_form: When the Subordinate is requesting wait states (HREADY=0), the Manager must not change the transfer type, except IDLE->NONSEQ (must then keep HTRANS constant until HREADY=HIGH), BUSY->SEQ (fixed-length burst), and BUSY->other (undefined-length burst).
properties.sva_form: // Transfer-type tracker: HTRANS changes during HREADY=0 limited to the three documented exceptions.

properties.english_form: A Subordinate must only sample HSELx, HADDR, and control signals when HREADY=HIGH (indicating the current transfer is completing).
properties.sva_form: // Subordinate input-sampling rule: latch only on rising HCLK when HREADY=HIGH.

properties.english_form: The minimum address space that can be allocated to a single Subordinate is 1KB, and the start and end of the address region must lie on a 1KB boundary.
properties.sva_form: // Address-map static check.

properties.english_form: If the memory map is incomplete, a default Subordinate must be implemented: ERROR for NONSEQ/SEQ to unmapped addresses; zero-wait OKAY for IDLE/BUSY.
properties.sva_form: // Default-slave check: NONSEQ/SEQ to undecoded address -> two-cycle ERROR; IDLE/BUSY -> zero-wait OKAY.

properties.english_form: AHB5: HEXCL marks an Exclusive transfer; HMASTER carries the unique Manager ID; HEXOKAY is returned by the Exclusive Access Monitor (1=success, 0=failure).
properties.sva_form: // Scoreboard: track (HADDR, HMASTER) at exclusive read; on exclusive write, compare against monitor; HEXOKAY consistent with monitor state.

properties.english_form: AHB5: HNONSEC is an address-phase signal and must be constant throughout a burst.
properties.sva_form: // Beat tracker: HNONSEC unchanged within a burst.

properties.english_form: HWSTRB has one strobe per 8 bits of HWDATA; HWSTRB[n] corresponds to HWDATA[(8n+7):8n]. HWSTRB is a data-phase signal with the same validity rules as HWDATA.
properties.sva_form: // Width check + temporal: HWSTRB held with HWDATA during the data phase.

properties.english_form: Every APB transfer takes at least two PCLK cycles (SETUP one cycle, ACCESS one or more cycles).
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge PCLK) disable iff (!PRESETn) ($rose(PSELx) && !PENABLE) |=> (PENABLE));

properties.english_form: The bus remains in SETUP for exactly one PCLK cycle and always moves to ACCESS on the next rising PCLK.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge PCLK) disable iff (!PRESETn) (PSELx && !PENABLE) |=> (PSELx && PENABLE));

properties.english_form: While PREADY=0 during ACCESS, the bridge must hold PADDR, PWRITE, PSELx, PENABLE, PWDATA, PSTRB, PPROT unchanged.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge PCLK) disable iff (!PRESETn) (PSELx && PENABLE && !PREADY) |=> $stable({PADDR, PWRITE, PSELx, PENABLE, PWDATA, PSTRB, PPROT}));

properties.english_form: PREADY can take any value when PENABLE is LOW. Peripherals with a fixed two-cycle access can tie PREADY HIGH.
properties.sva_form: // Permitted: PREADY combinational with internal-decode while PENABLE=0; sampled only at end-of-ACCESS.

properties.english_form: For read transfers the bus master must drive all bits of PSTRB LOW.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge PCLK) disable iff (!PRESETn) (PSELx && !PWRITE) |-> (PSTRB == '0));

properties.english_form: PSLVERR is only considered valid during the last cycle of an APB transfer, when PSEL, PENABLE, and PREADY are all HIGH.
properties.sva_form: // PSLVERR sampled only when {PSELx, PENABLE, PREADY} == 3'b111.

properties.english_form: APB peripherals are not required to support the PSLVERR pin. Where a peripheral does not include this pin the appropriate input to the APB bridge is tied LOW.
properties.sva_form: // Static structural: missing PSLVERR -> bridge sees LOW.

properties.english_form: PPROT (APB4) must remain unchanged while PREADY is LOW.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge PCLK) disable iff (!PRESETn) (PSELx && PENABLE && !PREADY) |=> $stable(PPROT));

properties.english_form: AHB-to-APB bridge maps PSLVERR back to HRESP=ERROR (HRESP[0]=1).
properties.sva_form: // Bridge property: PSLVERR=1 at APB completion -> HRESP=1 (two-cycle ERROR) on the AHB Subordinate port.

properties.english_form: AXI-to-APB bridge maps PSLVERR back to RRESP/BRESP = SLVERR (RRESP[1]/BRESP[1] = 1).
properties.sva_form: // Bridge property: PSLVERR=1 at APB completion -> RRESP=2'b10 or BRESP=2'b10 at the AXI port.

evidence.quote: Subordinates must always provide a zero wait state OKAY response to IDLE / BUSY transfers and the transfer must be ignored by the Subordinate.
Managers must not attempt to start an incrementing burst that crosses a 1KB address boundary. All transfers in a burst must be aligned to the address boundary equal to the size of the transfer.

When the Subordinate is requesting wait states, the Manager must not change the transfer type, except as described in: IDLE transfer; BUSY transfer fixed-length burst; BUSY transfer undefined length burst. ... When the Subordinate is requesting wait states, the Manager can only change the address once, except as described in: During an IDLE transfer; After an ERROR response.
ERROR response is a two-cycle response on HRESP.
Minimum address space 1KB on 1KB boundary. Default Subordinate provides ERROR for NONSEQ/SEQ to unmapped addresses, zero-wait OKAY for IDLE/BUSY.
HEXCL + HMASTER + HEXOKAY drive the Exclusive Access Monitor.
HNONSEC is an address phase signal and must be constant throughout a burst.
Every transfer takes at least two cycles.
The bus only remains in the SETUP state for one clock cycle and always moves to the ACCESS state on the next rising edge of the clock.
PSLVERR is only considered valid during the last cycle of an APB transfer, when PSEL, PENABLE, and PREADY are all HIGH.
From AHB to APB: PSLVERR -> HRESP=ERROR (HRESP[0]). From AXI to APB: PSLVERR -> RRESP/BRESP = SLVERR (RRESP[1]/BRESP[1]).
